status: Blocked for complete cycles throughout 2025 and 2026

missing_evidence: Class-specific monthly amounts actually billed, including the 523.17 environmental adjustment to 523.21 recovery, and their billing applicability. CPP may defer or over-recover purchased power. Its website lists factors without a dated application history.
